column6: Lady, you who wander among sweet-voiced cows and gentle-voiced calves in the cattle-pen; young woman, no sooner will you arrive there, @wDN{Inana}, than the churn should sound! May the churn of your spouse sound, @wDN{Inana}, may the churn of @wDN{Dumuzid} sound! May the churn sound, may the churn of @wDN{Dumuzid} sound!

The rocking of the churn will sing for you, @wDN{Inana}, thus making you joyous. The holy churn will sound …… for you, thus making you joyous, @wDN{Ninegala}. The good shepherd, the man of sweet songs, will loudly sing songs for you; lady, with the sweetest songs, @wDN{Inana}, may he make your heart joyous!

Lady, when you enter the cattle-pen, @wDN{Inana}, the cattle-pen indeed will rejoice over you. Mistress, when you enter the sheepfold, @wDN{Inana}, the sheepfold indeed will rejoice over you. When you enter the feeding-pen, healthy ewes will spread out their wool for you.

May your spouse, @wDN{Ama-ušumgal-ana}, …… on your holy breast. May the holy sheepfold produce plentiful supplies of butter for you. It will make butter plentiful, it will make milk plentiful, thus making you joyous, @wDN{Inana}. May the holy sheepfold make the butter extensive for you, thus making you joyous, @wDN{Ninegala}.

For the king you have chosen with your heart, for @wDN{Dumuzid}, the son of @wDN{Enlil}, may the cattle-pen produce butter and milk, may the sheepfold produce abundance! May the days of the true shepherd be numerous! The true shepherd, @wDN{Dumuzid} …… days of prosperity!
